name: japanese-furigana-ai-extension
description: A Chrome extension for local Japanese furigana and user-configured selection translation.

scripts.package:store: npm run build && npm run validate && python scripts/package-web-store.py
scripts.package:download: npm run build && npm run validate && python scripts/package-download.py
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:extension && npm run test:site && npm run validate
